items.title: Harold Christophe Interview, 1961-08-01
items.q: And I had him there, start out with, because I always take the older fellow with me on everything, because I figured like that, well, he knew.

ctx.x: Great tramp-owner. Great tramp-owner player. And I had him there, start out with, because I always take the older fellow with me on everything, because I figured like that, well, he knew. Yeah. You ought to have somebody as a guide, you know. Well, I took him, and another fellow played piano by the name of Penny, and another young fellow with me. I started at the same time, the name was Dick, and the boy played the drum. We had the two older ones, well, they kept us in line. And from that on, well, they began to…
Morris French and who else was there over?
